# Naamani Real Estate

> Adam Naamani is a licensed REALTOR® with eXp Realty in Greater Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada. He represents buyers, sellers, and investors, with more than 15 years in real estate and 3,000+ Lower Mainland homes valued.

## Key facts

- Name: Adam Kamal Naamani (Adam Naamani), REALTOR®
- Brokerage: eXp Realty, 1500-701 West Georgia Street, Vancouver, BC V7Y 1G6
- Licence: BC real estate representative, licence 180852
- Email: adam@naamanirealestate.com
- Areas served: Greater Vancouver and the Lower Mainland, including Vancouver, Burnaby, New Westminster, and Port Coquitlam
- Experience: 15+ years in Canadian real estate; 3,000+ Lower Mainland homes valued; $1.6B in property valued
- Credentials: Accredited Real Estate Negotiator; Diploma in Urban Land Economics; Bachelor of Business in Real Estate, UBC Sauder School of Business
- Founder of Resider Inc. (https://resider.ca), a British Columbia MLS® search platform
- Services: selling (pricing strategy and launch), buying (offer strategy and negotiation), investing (renovation and hold analysis), free no-obligation home valuations

## Timeline

- 2008: Started investing and renovating
- 2012: UBC Sauder, real estate
- 2013: Founded Resider Inc.
- 2021: Joined eXp Realty
